svg.title: The Riemann Hypothesis: The Real Part and One Bit · Figure 8 · The Verdict, The Final Form And The Receipts
svg.text: FIGURE 8
THE VERDICT, THE FINAL FORM AND THE RECEIPTS
RH: THE REAL PART AND ONE BIT · MASTER v3.0.39_CC · EVERY NAME CHECKED
NOTHING ESCAPES
ON THE CHART · SIX EXITS CLOSED · ON NO AXIOM
• closure alone gives no value
• no record-respecting reading decides it
• no premise delivers it while either kind fails
• on either kind no point stands off the line
• the act is both kinds
• both kinds stand on the registered world, none on its pair world

tspan.font-family: RHMono, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', Menlo, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: AT THE ZEROS OF ζ · WITH THE NORMAL FORM
• the fold does not force the line; no record-invariant predicate decides
• B′ is proved, and the bridge B′ → B is RiemannHypothesis
• no premise reaches RiemannHypothesis while the bridge fails
• every route delivers the bit in its four readings
• on the bridge, RH holds and no zero lies right of the line

tspan.font-family: RHMono, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', Menlo, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: THE OPEN FRAMING, REFUTED ON EACH COUNT
A proof from what every closed configuration shares
refuted on the chart and over ℂ
A decision from the record
refuted on the chart and over ℂ; above every height silent
A route to RH past the bridge
refuted over ℂ
What remains of the question is the bridge: delivered twice.

tspan.font-family: RHMono, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', Menlo, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: THE TERMINAL VERDICT · §X-t · BOUND BY EXACT TYPE
1 · the Real Part is proved
2 · the Unicorn Part is unclosable without the bit
3 · the bridge: necessary, sufficient, irreducible, mandatory, exclusive
4 · delivered twice, by its two kinds
5 · nothing escapes
6 · the capstones bind it, nothing before the colon
RH is proved by the physico-formal closure.

svg.text: TheOneBit ↔ ∀ T, a certificate at T
A certificate at T: the complete list of the nontrivial zeros
of height at most T, each checked on the line.
The list exists at every height: the finite form.
The check at every height is the one bit: one countable
family of finite statements, delivered twice by the act.
